WriterCasa uses advanced AI models to help you write better. You can ask it to continue your writing, expand ideas, rewrite sections for clarity, shorten verbose text, or brainstorm new concepts. The AI learns your style and provides contextual suggestions while you always remain in control.

records.name: Arky
records.tagline: Your canvas for thinking with AI
records.description: Introducing Arky, your AI thinking canvas. Arky is derived from the word “architect.” It's a canvas where you shape and assemble your thoughts with AI. Traditional writing tools lock you into a top-down flow — great for output, but too rigid for thinking. Design canvases give you spatial freedom, but no structure to build on. Arky brings both together. On a canvas, using markdown-based hierarchy, you can architect your ideas and develop them with AI — at every step of the process! ❤️‍🔥

records.name: Hello Aria
records.tagline: Turn chats into tasks, reminders & notes — instantly.
records.description: Stop switching between 5 apps. Just message Aria. HelloAria is the AI productivity assistant that lives inside WhatsApp, Telegram, email, and your iOS app. Manage reminders, tasks, calendar, notes, and meeting minutes — all from a single chat. Too busy to type? Send a voice note — Aria turns it into tasks, notes, and action items automatically. Syncs with Google Calendar, Drive, Meet, Outlook, and One AI. Endless uses. All your productivity in a single chat.

records.name: Geekflare Scraping API v2
records.tagline: RAG-ready web scraping that cuts your LLM token costs
records.description: Feeding raw data directly into your AI agents eats up context windows and spikes your OpenAI and Anthropic costs. Earlier this year, we launched standard HTML, JSON, and Markdown extraction. Today, we are introducing outputs built entirely for AI: markdown-llm, text-llm, and html-llm. We automatically strip out navbars, footers, ads, and scripts, delivering only the context your models actually need. You can save up to 85% on tokens compared to raw HTML when using text-llm output format.

records.name: Athena
records.tagline: Claude Code for Product Teams
records.description: Athena is an AI-powered product workspace that helps teams stop guessing and start building with clarity. Powered by AI subagents, Athena understands your product and acts as a thinking partner - connecting context, challenging assumptions, and guiding better decisions so you can validate faster and build what actually matters.

records.name: Studio – The AI-Native Media Workspace
records.tagline: Organize, tag and edit thousands of photos at once with AI
records.description: We built Studio for the professionals who work with photos and videos on a daily basis: Studio is the world’s most powerful media workspace that lets you “talk” with photos and videos. With Studio, you can unleash the power of your visual media with AI-powered search, organization, tagging, analysis and editing. The full power of Vision AI, no Jupyter notebooks or python scripts!

records.name: Prio
records.tagline: Your AI chief of staff for email, calendar, and tasks
records.description: Prio is an AI chief of staff (Executive Assistant) for founders. One chat to manage your inbox, calendar, tasks, and contacts across Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, and Drive. Every action; emails, meetings, follow-ups are going through an approval queue. nothing executes without your OK. Over time, Prio learns from your approvals and starts automating routine actions automatically. High-stakes decisions always stay in your hands. EU hosted, GDPR native.

records.name: Ichiba AI
records.tagline: AI to AI influence, scored. See what moves the models.
records.description: Ichiba is a live AI influence arena. AI agents compete to shift each other's product recommendations. Every session scored turn by turn, every tactic classified, every move measured. 1,000+ sessions run across 12 categories. Trust tactics beat authority tactics by 19 points. Dark GEO tactics (synthetic consensus, memory poisoning, dual-layer messaging) are already targeting AI recommendation engines. Ichiba makes them visible. Solo founder. Patents pending.

records.name: Spotlight
records.tagline: AI visibility audits for websites — spot gaps, get fixes
records.description: Spotlight crawls your site and maps the buyer questions your content should answer. It then runs those questions through AI systems with grounded search and checks whether you get cited — or a competitor does instead. The dashboard shows you which intents your pages cover strongly, which are weak, and which are missing entirely. For each gap, it surfaces the pages being cited instead and gives you specific recommendations to fix them.

records.name: AI Mode in Chrome
records.tagline: Browse and search side-by-side, without switching tabs
records.description: AI Mode in Chrome opens websites alongside your search so you can ask follow-up questions in context. Add open tabs, images, or PDFs as inputs. For everyday Chrome users on desktop.

records.name: Pollo Assistance
records.tagline: The all-in-one AI suite for students, creators & developers.
records.description: Pollo Assistance is a comprehensive AI ecosystem designed to eliminate tool fatigue. Instead of constantly switching between applications, Pollo offers a unified workspace with specialized modules for every need. Manage your data with FILES, write and debug with CODE, master your subjects with STUDY, and create professional content with EDUWORD. Fully available in English, Pollo provides a seamless, intuitive, and powerful experience for students, developers, and creators worldwide.

records.name: pompelmi: Minimal wrapper around ClamAV
records.tagline: Minimal Node.js wrapper around ClamAV
records.description: Minimal Node.js wrapper around ClamAV — scan any file and get Clean, Malicious, or ScanError. Handles installation and database updates automatically.

records.name: The Coach - Handball Lineup
records.tagline: Auto lineup builder & team manager for coaches
records.description: Most amateur handball coaches still write lineups on paper or WhatsApp. The Coach fixes that. Auto-generates lineups based on squad availability, drag-and-drop court builder, live game tracking with goals, assists & saves, and season stats that build up automatically. Built for youth coaches, club teams, and recreational leagues. No account required — all data stays on your device.

records.name: EasyHR
records.tagline: Built for HR. Loved by Employees
records.description: EasyHR is a modern, employee-friendly HRMS platform that streamlines the entire hire-to-retire lifecycle. It helps HR teams automate routine tasks and focus on strategic work. Key features include compliant payroll processing for India, real-time attendance and leave management, and a centralized HR helpdesk—ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and a better employee experience.

records.name: BOGAMI
records.tagline: Cryptographic photo proof — impossible to fake or deny
records.description: In the age of AI deepfakes, BOGAMI cryptographically signs your photos the moment you take them — anchored on Solana blockchain. No wallet required. ✅ C2PA Metadata baked in at capture ✅ Solana anchoring — tamper-proof, forever ✅ Steganographic watermark that survives compression ✅ One-tap verification for anyone Use cases: insurance fraud, anti-catfishing, journalism, legal docs. Android-first. iOS coming soon. Stop guessing. Start proving.

records.name: SANCTUM
records.tagline: Secure SSH access orchestration for your teams
records.description: SANCTUM is the SSH access layer your team stops thinking about. Install one cron line on each server and every engineer, every key, every environment lives in one place. Users converge, access revokes propagate, sudo rotates, and nothing drifts. No daemons to install, no LDAP to babysit. Onboard a new hire in a minute, offboard them in the next. Built for startups and platform teams that have outgrown copy-pasting authorized_keys but aren't ready for a six-figure PAM contract.

records.name: ytest.ai
records.tagline: Test Automation That Actually Works
records.description: Enterprise test automation powered by AI. Automate SAP GUI, browser testing, mobile testing and API testing with natural language. 14-day free trial.

records.name: iLinkVault
records.tagline: Your Links. Organized by AI. Private by Default.
records.description: Save links from any app, ask AI to find them instantly, and keep sensitive bookmarks private. iLinkVault works on iOS and Android with Chrome browser extension sync. Free to start.

records.name: Gymary
records.tagline: Ultimate fitness companion
records.description: Elevate your fitness journey with Gymary, the ultimate workout companion designed for gym-goers of all levels. 🏋️‍♂️ Effortlessly log your sets, track your strength gains, and visualize your progress with intuitive analytics. Whether you’re following a professional program or building your own routine, Gymary keeps you focused and motivated. Stay consistent, hit your PRs, and transform your body with ease. 🚀 Simple, powerful, and built for results. Download Gymary today!

records.name: Productify
records.tagline: Build lasting habits with AI insights, streaks and goals
records.description: Productify is a habit tracker for people who want to build routines without the pressure. While many habit apps feel rigid or overly gamified, Productify is designed to feel calmer and more supportive. It includes Habit Duo for accountability with a friend, an AI Habit Analyzer for personal insights, flexible goals, templates, and streaks that encourage you to keep going after missed days instead of making you feel like you failed.

records.name: Linkedln AI Assistant
records.tagline: create viral posts, comments & summarize content instantly
records.description: Write smarter LinkedIn comments, create viral posts, and summarize content instantly — all in one powerful AI-powered browser extension. Stand out, save time, and grow your presence on LinkedIn effortlessly. ⚡ Features ✔ Generate high-quality comments in seconds ✔ Create viral-style LinkedIn posts that drive engagement ✔ Summarize long posts into quick insights ✔ Works seamlessly inside your LinkedIn feed ✔ Lightweight, fast, and easy to use

records.name: Torensa Song Identifier
records.tagline: Use your microphone to identify any playing song in seconds.
records.description: Wondering what song is playing? Use your microphone to identify any song in seconds. This free online song finder records a short audio clip, recognizes it against a database of over 100 million tracks, and returns the song title, artist, album, and genre. Get direct streaming links to Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Amazon Music, and Deezer. Works with music from speakers, TV, radio, or even humming — no app install required.

records.name: Grade to CGPA Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate your CGPA instantly with ease
records.description: CGPA Calculator helps you calculate your cumulative grade point average quickly and accurately. Simply enter your subjects, grades, and credit hours to get instant results. 🔹 Supports 10-point (India) and 4-point (USA) grading scales 🔹 Add multiple subjects easily 🔹 Instant and accurate CGPA calculation 🔹 Simple, fast, and beginner-friendly 🔹 100% free – no signup required Perfect for students who want to track their academic performance effortlessly.

records.name: Complete Cybersecurity Guide 2026
records.tagline: Discover the best products of April 2026
records.description: Get the latest cybersecurity news, including data breaches, ransomware attacks, malware threats, hacking incidents, and global cyber security updates. Stay informed about the newest cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and digital security developments worldwide.

records.name: AlphaTubes
records.tagline: Sort letters, solve word
records.description: Most mobile games are filled with ads. AlphaTubes isn’t. AlphaTubes is a daily word puzzle where you move letters between tubes to form hidden words—a water sort-style game with a real twist. No ads. No distractions. Just clean, satisfying gameplay. Features: • Daily challenges • Achievements & streaks • Simple mechanics, real challenge Built for people who just want to play.

records.name: CollectNow
records.tagline: From overdue to paid. Automatically.
records.description: Automate invoice reminders and AI-powered negotiation to turn overdue invoices into cash faster.

records.name: Cortex Memory MCP
records.tagline: Universal Long-Term Memory for AI Agents via MCP
records.description: Stop repeating yourself to AI. Cortex Protocol is a universal long-term memory layer for every AI user. Designed for simplicity, it gives your AI a permanent brain that grows with you. Whether you use Cursor, Claude, or custom agents, your context and preferences are persisted across every session. Cortex isn’t just for developers; it’s for anyone who wants a more personal, forget-proof AI experience. One configuration, infinite memory. Give your AI the brain it deserves.

records.name: SFX Stacks
records.tagline: Find sounds in local SFX libraries with plain words
records.description: SFX Stacks is a desktop app for searching large local SFX libraries. Instead of relying only on filenames, metadata, or folder browsing, it lets you describe the sound you need and explore similar sounds, making search faster and improving discovery. Built for sound designers, game audio, and other audio workflows with large local libraries.

records.name: DB Explorer
records.tagline: Modern AI‑first database client
records.description: DB Explorer brings together everything you need to work with databases efficiently: • AI‑powered SQL Assistant • Real‑time database health monitoring • Automatic schema diagrams • Fast query execution • Support for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, and more If you work with data, this tool helps you explore, debug, visualize, and understand your database faster. Demo Video - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_NXphANViKM Download - https://sourceforge.net/projects/db-explorer/files/

records.name: Elvan
records.tagline: Turn customer feedback into decisions with AI
records.description: Next-generation, AI-native feedback platform to collect NPS, CSAT, and CES across product, email, embed, and tools like Zendesk and Salesforce. Trigger surveys at the right moment across every touchpoint, then analyze every response with AI to uncover sentiment, themes, and churn signals. Responses stream to Slack in real time so teams can act instantly. No complex builders. No manual tagging. Just clear signals that help you build better products.

records.name: Cloudflare Email Service
records.tagline: Turn any email inbox into a native interface for AI agents
records.description: Agents are becoming multi-channel. That means making them available wherever your users already are — including the inbox. Today, Cloudflare Email Service enters public beta with the infrastructure layer to make that easy: send, receive, and process email natively from your agents.

records.name: SpeechPal
records.tagline: The practice room for real life conversations
records.description: Most people don't lack the words — they lack the practice. SpeechPal gives you a safe space to rehearse any real life situation, from job interviews, presentations and meetings, and get instant AI feedback on how you came across. Situation based practice. Feedback that cuts to what matters. Compare multiple takes and find your best self. No fluff. Just you, your voice, and the confidence to use it.

records.name: DJI Osmo Pocket 4
records.tagline: The world in your pocket, now in 4K/240fps
records.description: DJI Osmo Pocket 4 pushes the pocket gimbal camera into a much more serious imaging system: 1-inch CMOS, 4K/240fps, 14-stop dynamic range, 10-bit D-Log, 2× lossless zoom, built-in storage, and faster pro-grade workflow features in a device that still fits in your pocket.

records.name: NearHome
records.tagline: Quickly map the closely points of interest from any address
records.description: You're a homebuyer using Google Maps to scout various houses. Google Maps does many things incredibly well. But one thing it can't do is take an address and simultaneously find and map the nearest points of interest. With NearHome, you enter an address, pick the categories you care about, enter custom locations (e.g. work) and instantly see how centrally located the address is. You can also save your search criteria to use with other addresses, and view school district and flood data.

records.name: MyFlightMaps
records.tagline: Your Flighty flights, beautifully mapped
records.description: Import your Flighty exports and see all your flights beautifully rendered on an interactive map that you can share with your family and friends. Track your travels, share your adventures.

records.name: MailTest
records.tagline: Most tools say DKIM failed. MailTest tells you why
records.description: SPF ✅ DKIM ✅ DMARC ✅ — yet your emails still land in spam? Most tools just say "DKIM failed" without explaining WHY. MailTest goes deeper: 12 technical checks + actionable insights that show you exactly what's broken and how to fix it. Self-hosted, open source (after 100 users), built for developers who need real answers, not just red/green checkmarks. Try it free: 3 tests/day, no credit card.

records.name: ApplyBtn
records.tagline: Autofill job applications with AI on any job page
records.description: ApplyBtn autofills job applications directly on the job page. It matches your CV to each job, generates tailored answers and cover letters. - Context-aware, non-robotic answers tailored to each job - Supports multiple languages - Choose between multiple CVs for different roles - Free to start - No subscription - No dashboards or long questionnaires - Simple to use directly on the job page - Refine answers multiple times - No auto-submission - you stay in control

records.name: ChurnQ
records.tagline: AI agent that saves subscribers when they try to cancel
records.description: Most cancel buttons do nothing. ChurnQ fights back. Aria (AI agent) intercepts cancel clicks, learns why they're leaving, and makes a personalised offer instantly. Also handles: → Failed payment recovery with smart retries → Churn prediction before subscribers hit cancel → AI Analyst ask why people leave, get real answers One script tag. Live in 5 minutes. No save? No charge.

records.name: Recommended App
records.tagline: Earn commissions recommending local businesses you love
records.description: A people-powered local discovery platform where rideshare drivers, bartenders, teachers, and church leaders earn commissions by recommending local experiences and services. Free to join. 44,000+ local businesses across 300+ US cities with verified reviews. Community-driven recommendations, not algorithm-driven ads. Join thousands earning commissions by recommending local tours, restaurants, events, home services, and more. Free to join, real earnings.

records.name: WalletFlow
records.tagline: Self-custody crypto wallet made simple
records.description: WalletFlow is a self-custody crypto wallet that makes security feel simple. Your keys stay yours, protected with distributed encryption, while your wallet syncs seamlessly across all your devices. No seed phrase anxiety, no confusing UX. Learn crypto by doing with a guided experience, step-by-step actions like buying, sending, and swapping. True ownership, without the complexity.

records.name: Nudge CRM
records.tagline: The action-oriented CRM
records.description: Nudge is a simple, single-purpose, action-oriented CRM that keeps every deal moving with a clear next step. Add deals manually, or import from any spreadsheet with our AI-powered mapping tools, then assign an owner and a due date so nothing just sits in the pipeline. Your Today view shows what needs attention so you know how to keep deals moving forward, without digging through notes or Slack threads. CC your workspace on outbound emails to attach them to contacts. For mobile and desktop.
